definitions.gloss: presence or absence, whether something exists
definitions.explanation: Whether something is present or not; the question of existence or non-existence. Used in formal and written contexts to ask about or indicate whether something applies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有無|うむ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問|と}いません→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: Experience is not required. (Lit: We do not ask about the presence or absence of experience.)

examples.japanese: {有無|うむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}わさず⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧いかれた。
examples.english: I was taken away without being allowed to say a word.
examples.notes: {有無|うむ}を{言|い}わさず is a set expression meaning 'without allowing any objection'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有無|うむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm whether you have the qualifications when applying.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in formal and written Japanese, especially on forms and in official contexts. The pattern ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有無|うむ} asks whether something exists or applies. The set phrase {有無|うむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}わさず means 'without allowing objection; giving no choice'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有無|うむ}: whether one has experience
- ⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有無|うむ}: whether one has qualifications
- {有無|うむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}わさず: without allowing any objection
- {有無|うむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check presence or absence
